content.content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: influx
  labels:
    app: influx
spec:
  replicas: 1
  serviceName: influx
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: influx
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: influx
    spec:
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 2
      containers:
      - name: influx
        image: busybox:1.36
        imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
        command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - mkdir -p /data; [ -f /data/payload.txt ] || echo "$(hostname) $(date -u
          +%FT%TZ) records" > /data/payload.txt; exec httpd -f -p 8080
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        resources:
          requests:
            cpu: 10m
            memory: 16Mi
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 64Mi
        env:
        - name: MODE
          value: b
        volumeMounts:
        - name: data
          mountPath: /data
  volumeClaimTemplates:
  - metadata:
      name: data
    spec:
      accessModes:
      - ReadWriteOnce
      storageClassName: standard
      resources:
        requests:
          storage: 128Mi
  persistentVolumeClaimRetentionPolicy:
    whenDeleted: Delete
    whenScaled: Retain
